headline: England's Transplant Team Wins First World Cup
meta_description: England's transplant football team claimed their first World Cup title with a dominant 5-1 victory over Spain in Frankfurt, Germany.
summary_short: England's transplant football team are world champions for the first time after thrashing Spain 5-1 in Frankfurt, taking revenge after Spain knocked them out in 2024.
body:
England's transplant football team are world champions for the first time. They defeated Spain 5-1 on Friday in Frankfurt, Germany, claiming the crown in emphatic style.

The victory marks sweet revenge for the team, who were knocked out by Spain at the previous World Cup in 2024. Manager Daley Cross, from Bicester, Oxfordshire, witnessed the determination firsthand. "I could just see in their eyes that they wanted it," he said of his squad's mindset from the start of the tournament.

The dominant performance in the final demonstrated the team's hunger to bring the trophy home, overcoming the heartbreak of their previous elimination to achieve a historic milestone.
quick_facts: England's transplant team won 5-1 against Spain
Final played in Frankfurt, Germany on Friday
Manager Daley Cross from Bicester, Oxfordshire
Revenge victory after Spain knocked them out in 2024
First World Cup title in team history
